description:

Tracking Engineer / Digital Analytics Engineer

We are looking for a Tracking Engineer to own end-to-end analytics implementation across a complex, global digital ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of business, data, and engineering, ensuring accurate, scalable, and high‑quality measurement across web, mobile, OTT, and emerging platforms.

• Ensure all new and existing products and features are accurately measured, validated, and reported across devices

• Manage releases and ensure successful tracking deployment and validation in fast-paced environments

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree preferred (STEM a plus, not required)

• 2+ years of experience in analytics implementation or relevant internship experience

• Strong familiarity with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Tealium, Adobe Launch, or similar tools

• Highly autonomous, self‑starter mindset with excellent time management skills

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and creative thinking capabilities

• Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non‑technical audiences

• Curiosity-driven mindset with a passion for learning and continuous improvement

Additional Qualifications (Nice to Have)

• Experience in data analytics, data quality, data warehousing, data governance, business intelligence, data visualization, or data privacy

• Hands-on coding experience with Java, Python, or similar languages

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence

• Advanced experience deploying analytics through tag management systems

• Deep implementation expertise with Adobe Analytics or similar enterprise platforms

• Experience leading or influencing analytics architecture across multiple sites and distributed teams

• Demonstrated initiative to stay current with evolving analytics and tracking technologies

title: Senior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Writer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:

Nice to have:

To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your profile, if available

  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.

  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.

  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.

  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).

title: Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre.


About Fullinfo

Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform.

The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources.


The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense.


The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say.


Role description

As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform.

This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable.

You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly.


Your work includes:

• Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Closer Jurídico
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Closer Jurídico em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Oportunidade de Carreira: Closer Jurídico Senior


LER COM EXTREMA ATENÇÃO


Estamos em busca de um(a) Closer Jurídico com perfil analítico, excelente comunicação e foco estratégico em conversão de clientes. Somos um escritório de advocacia boutique em fase de expansão de nossa estrutura comercial e buscamos um profissional para liderar o fechamento de novos negócios.

Se você possui sólida experiência em fechamento de contratos de serviços jurídicos, agilidade no atendimento de demandas e busca uma oportunidade com perspectiva real de crescimento para cargos de liderança, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Gestão de Inbound (Tráfego Pago): Atendimento imediato e qualificado dos leads oriundos de campanhas digitais. A agilidade no primeiro contato é um fator crítico de sucesso para esta função.
  • Prospecção Ativa (Outbound): Abordagem consultiva e estratégica de potenciais clientes a partir de listas qualificadas fornecidas pelo escritório.
  • Condução de Reuniões Estratégicas: Realizar reuniões de diagnóstico e fechamento (via videoconferência ou presenciais), conduzindo a negociação, superando objeções complexas e apresentando propostas de valor.
  • Gestão do Funil de Vendas: Manter o CRM atualizado de forma rigorosa, garantindo um acompanhamento (follow-up) eficiente de cada oportunidade.
  • Foco em Resultados: Conversão efetiva de leads em contratos assinados, visando o atingimento das metas de faturamento do escritório.
⚙️ Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Experiência prévia e comprovada como Closer Jurídico (fechamento de contratos de prestação de serviços advocatícios).
  • Domínio de técnicas de vendas consultivas e negociação complexa aplicadas ao mercado jurídico.
  • Alta prontidão e agilidade: Capacidade de resposta rápida no atendimento a leads de tráfego pago.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, postura corporativa e capacidade de interlocução com clientes de diferentes perfis.
  • Organização e disciplina para o cumprimento de metas de desempenho.
Condições e Benefícios
  • Regime de Contratação: Prestador de Serviços (PJ).
  • Jornada de Trabalho: Período integral.
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido (mínimo de 2 dias por semana presenciais na sede do escritório para alinhamento estratégico, e os demais dias em regime de home office).
  • Remuneração: Honorário fixo compatível com o mercado + Comissão atrativa por contrato fechado (remuneração variável com base em desempenho).
  • Perspectiva de Carreira: O profissional que se destacar no atingimento de metas estruturará a área comercial, com plano de transição futura para a posição de Gerente ou Diretor Comercial .

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.
  • Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality.
  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution.
  • Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines.
  • Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.

  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.

Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Software Develper

  • JavaScript → Level: Advanced → Mandatory

  • Construir e manter o backend escalável utilizando Node.js (NestJS) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot).

  • Experiência comprovada de 5+ anos na área de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento frontend: React, SPA, roteamento, componentização e consumo de APIs.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em TypeScript, CSS e SCSS/SASS para desenvolvimento responsivo.
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento backend com Node.js (NestJS com estrutura modular, controllers, services, providers e injeção de dependência) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot).
  • Experiência prática na arquitetura de microsserviços e desenvolvimento/consumo de APIs REST e SOAP (JSON, autenticação e integração).
  • Perfil de liderança técnica com excelente capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria.

title: AI Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Creative Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across a diverse range of genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As an AI Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of voice design and performance across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and expertise in AI Voice design Tools.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

4. AI-driven Innovations and tool adoption

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.

5. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

6. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

9. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, voice design, post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with Pro Tools, Elevenlabs, and similar platforms.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

description:

Sua próxima oportunidade está a caminho!


A VILT é uma empresa de TI, onde valorizamos nosso pessoal, promovemos o trabalho em equipe e, é claro, o bom humor.


Acreditamos que a diversidade e a inclusão fortalecem o nosso time. Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, e profissionais com deficiência (PCDs) são incentivados a se candidatar.

Dê uma olhada nesta oportunidade de emprego e veja se você é o próximo VILTian! (se você conhece alguém, não se esqueça de recomendá-lo)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Líder Técnico para atuar na liderança técnica, definição arquitetural e evolução de aplicações modernas e escaláveis. O papel exige sólida experiência no ecossistema de microsserviços e APIs, transitando com autonomia entre o backend e o frontend. No ecossistema backend, o desafio envolve o domínio de Node.js (NestJS) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot), com integrações complexas via REST e SOAP. No frontend, a atuação é focada em React e TypeScript para a construção de SPAs responsivas e componentizadas. Além disso, o escopo contempla a disseminação de boas práticas para o time e a interface com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura básica em nuvem (AWS e CI/CD).


O que você irá fazer:

  • Atuar com autonomia técnica na liderança de times de desenvolvimento e na definição de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações modernas baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços e orientadas a APIs.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas do projeto e apoiar na disseminação de boas práticas de engenharia para a equipe.
  • Garantir a entrega de interfaces responsivas, componentizadas e de alta performance utilizando React e TypeScript.
  • Construir e manter o backend escalável utilizando Node.js (NestJS) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot).
  • Garantir a integração eficiente e segura entre serviços utilizando APIs REST e SOAP.
  • Apoiar na cultura DevOps, lidando com noções de CI/CD, pipelines, automação de deploy e API Gateway.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada de 5+ anos na área de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento frontend: React, SPA, roteamento, componentização e consumo de APIs.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em TypeScript, CSS e SCSS/SASS para desenvolvimento responsivo.
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento backend com Node.js (NestJS com estrutura modular, controllers, services, providers e injeção de dependência) e Java 17+ (Spring Boot).
  • Experiência prática na arquitetura de microsserviços e desenvolvimento/consumo de APIs REST e SOAP (JSON, autenticação e integração).
  • Perfil de liderança técnica com excelente capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimentos práticos e noções em nuvem AWS (infraestrutura básica, serviços de cloud e deploy).
  • Experiência na configuração e otimização de pipelines de CI/CD e gerenciamento de API Gateways.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento de software para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: SDR & Client Acquisition Specialist (Brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDR & Client Acquisition Specialist (Brasil) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SDR & Client Acquisition Specialist, Remote | Part-Time R$1,500 – R$2,000/month + performance bonuses (potential to grow to full-time)


We're a UK-based performance marketing agency working with aesthetics and beauty clinics. We're looking for a confident, organised SDR to both work inbound leads for our clients AND help us grow the agency through outbound prospecting.


What You'll Do:

  • Call inbound leads quickly after submission and book them into consultations
  • Follow up with warm and cold leads consistently
  • Qualify prospects and handle objections professionally
  • Reach out to potential new clients for the agency via cold calls, DMs and email
  • Log all activity in the CRM and keep pipelines clean and accurate
  • Work closely with the marketing team and report daily on results


What We're Looking For:

  • Strong spoken English is ESSENTIAL —> you must be able to communicate clearly, naturally, and confidently at a near-native or fully fluent level, with excellent pronunciation and strong conversational ability
  • Comfortable making high volumes of calls
  • Experience with cold calling and CRM systems (GoHighLevel preferred)
  • Organised, reliable, and hungry to grow
  • Proactive by nature — you don't wait to be told what to do
  • Someone who takes full ownership of their results — no excuses
  • Willing to learn, improve, and take feedback seriously


This is NOT for you if:

  • You need constant hand-holding
  • You make excuses instead of making calls
  • You're looking for something easy and low-effort
  • You avoid accountability when things don't go your way


This IS for you if:

  • You're self-driven and take initiative
  • You own your results — good and bad
  • You're hungry to learn and grow with a team
  • You want a role where performance is actually rewarded


Bonus Points:

  • Experience with UK or US clients
  • Background in high-ticket services or consultation booking
  • Familiarity with marketing funnels and CRM automations


Compensation & Growth:

  • Base: R$1,500 – R$2,000/month (part-time)
  • Performance bonuses for strong results
  • Real opportunity to grow into a full-time role for the right person

Hard workers who take ownership get rewarded here. If that's you — apply below.


To apply: send a 60-second voice note in English introducing yourself and why you're the right person for this role.

* Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade;

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

• Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Lead Developer to join our growing engineering team. This role combines hands-on senior development with day-to-day team leadership, working closely with the CTO. You will design and build software while also manage day-to-day engineering operations - including ticket creation and assignment, PR oversight, and team processes.


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is technically strong and has prior experience in a lead role - someone who enjoys writing production code, mentoring a talented senior team, and helping coordinate the day-to-day workflow so the CTO can focus on higher-level direction.


You will work across application code and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with the CTO to deliver scalable, reliable systems and keep a high-performing team running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Engineering Operations

• Work closely with the CTO to manage day-to-day engineering workload and ensure the team stays productive and unblocked

• Own ticket creation, triage, and assignment, keeping the backlog healthy and priorities clear

• Oversee pull request processes, ensuring code quality standards are upheld and reviews are timely

• Maintain and improve engineering processes and standards across a predominantly senior team

• Ensure strong database practices are followed across the team, including schema design, query efficiency, and data integrity

• Serve as a technical point of contact for escalations, cross-team coordination, and architectural decisions


Software Development & Feature Delivery

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET

• Build application features that interact deeply with the database, balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability

• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems

• Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack

• Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers


Azure Cloud & DevOps

• Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure, with a focus on reliability and observability

• Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps

• Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution

• Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost


Required Qualifications


Experience & Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development

• Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency)


Technical Skills (Priority Order)

• Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework

• Proven experience in a lead or senior lead developer role, assisting engineering management with day-to-day team operations

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL knowledge from a developer perspective
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs

• Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including App Services, Storage, and Azure SQL Database

• Experience integrating with third-party APIs

• CRM system experience and familiarity with common CRM integration patterns

• Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps


Soft Skills

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability

• Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams


Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with communications platforms and APIs such as Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, or similar for SMS, voice, and messaging workflows

• Familiarity with real-time communications protocols: VoIP, WebRTC, and SIP

• Experience with open-source telephony platforms such as Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

• Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)

• Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations

• Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments


What We Offer

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience

• Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions

• A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

  • Plan and coordinate disaster recovery (DR) testing activities across enterprise applications and services

  • Support the adoption of automated and continuous testing practices for production systems

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on testing efficiency and DR process enhancements
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional DR team members and stakeholders

  • Support additional DR-related activities and initiatives as assigned by leadership

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems.

Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads

  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL

  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $6.000 USD

English C1 required


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.


What You Will Need

  • Strong Technical Expertise :
  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

  • Conhecimento em estrutura de páginas, templates e componentes no AEM;

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.

title: Especialista Azure AI
description:

title: PMO - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PMO - brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender uma multinacional líder global no segmento de bens de consumo e transformação digital, com atuação em projetos estratégicos de tecnologia, inovação e expansão internacional.

Estamos buscando profissionais para atuar em iniciativas globais e LATAM relacionadas à transformação digital, omnichannel, AI e implementação de sistemas corporativos , com forte interação entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar na gestão de projetos estratégicos e programas corporativos
  • Garantir acompanhamento de cronograma, escopo, riscos, custos e qualidade
  • Coordenar stakeholders locais e globais
  • Conduzir governança, status reports e fóruns executivos
  • Atuar na integração entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital e implementação de sistemas
  • Garantir alinhamento entre times multidisciplinares
  • Atuar de forma hands-on na resolução de temas críticos e acompanhamento das entregas


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como PMO ou em gestão de projetos complexos

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.
